acceptance_criteria: Canonical Fashion Theme Team source, vendor, and installed-cache distributions verify and remain byte-identical.
FASHN credentials load from macOS Keychain first and test or CI environment fallback never leaks secrets.
Model Create and Try-On Max paid submissions are one-shot and provider-reported credit headers are mandatory.
Model-plate preflight, execute, and independent-review receipts bind immutable fingerprints, sources, outputs, jobs, and actual usage.
VTO prepare performs no paid POST and returns PASS_PENDING_APPROVAL only after source, authority, output, and balance checks pass.
A front-facing LH-003 review directly proves both side zippers and explicitly does not claim rendered rear-pocket or full-360 proof.
Comfy discovers the active Desktop runtime at port 8189, checks required nodes and BiRefNet, transfers inputs and outputs through the API, and records prompt/history evidence.
Runway is restricted to separately approved product-free background plates; protected customer, product, and sculpture RGB is composed locally.
BR and Signature contracts select protected composition, selective VTO, or mask-bound correction according to actual authority gaps.
All relevant checks pass and the PR is independently reviewed before merge.
